responsibility: Implements the frontend’s model of runtime functions callable from generated Go code, including the table-driven mapping from runtime names to parameter/result type signatures, lazy construction of corresponding `Named_object` declarations, type adaptation for call arguments, and helpers to build runtime call expressions. It also converts the runtime-support types to backend form and resolves runtime function codes by name for builtin and lowering logic.
same_name_distinction: Implements runtime-helper handling by turning the `runtime.def` catalog into actual frontend declarations, type objects, argument conversions, and runtime call expressions. Unlike `runtime.def`, which is only the raw table, and `runtime.h`, which only exposes the API, this file contains the logic that interprets that catalog for lowering and builtin resolution.
